records.subject: Picking back up with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Rafael,

No pressure, just a nudge: your workspace is still here whenever you're ready to pick it back up.

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Summit Ventures!
records.body:
Hi Rafael,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Summit Ventures* just joined on the pro plan!

decisions.rationale: Account is 6 days old, created a first project early (2026-09-10) but no activity or key milestone since, and no invites sent. Three Wrenfield emails (email:e52aedc6, email:73da329c, email:5bd8e3dd) with zero customer replies and no tickets suggest low engagement; 8 days left makes unaided activation possible but unlikely.

draft.subject: Next step in your Wrenfield workspace
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

Following up on my last note. You've got a first project created, which is the main thing — projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them.

If it would help to have a second pair of eyes in there, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week be useful? I'm happy to walk through whatever you'd like to get set up next.

Best,
Chidi
